content: I want to formally verify concurrent C programs, and as a first step, I used GPT-5.5 to port the CompCert C semantics from Rocq to Lean 4. The next step would be to port an axiomatic semantics of C concurrency to Lean 4, create a hybrid semantics, and then do some kind of reasoning framework (sequentially consistent reasoning perhaps) on top of that. Is there existing work that does reasoning on top of this kind of hybrid semantics?
